# Credits

The VT350 is built on other people's work. This page lists every upstream project the repository redistributes (the files [`REUSE.toml`](REUSE.toml) labels) and every one whose parts the [public reference pages](https://dvystrcil.github.io/vt350/) show (the parts [`cad/viewer/licences.json`](cad/viewer/licences.json) clears). Each keeps its own licence; the licence texts are in [`LICENSES/`](LICENSES/).

Everything not credited here is this project's own work, under [GPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSES/GPL-3.0-or-later.txt). The repository and its pages are non-commercial: nothing here is sold, and the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and GrabCAD parts are shown on that basis only.
